为什么“直接空气捕集”（DAC）成本远高于点源捕集？

Why is direct air capture (DAC) far costlier than point-source capture?

电厂烟气CO2浓度可达10–15%，而空气仅约0.04%，DAC需处理巨量空气并克服极低分压差，能耗与设备巨大，故成本每吨数百美元，远高于点源。
Flue gas has 10–15% CO2 but air only ~0.04%; DAC must process huge air volumes against a tiny partial-pressure gap, with large energy and plant costs—hundreds of dollars per ton, far above point sources.

#CCUS #DAC #成本

用CO2驱油（EOR）是“封存”还是“增产石油”？

Is CO2-enhanced oil recovery (EOR) 'storage' or 'more oil'?

两者兼有：注入CO2提高采收率并部分永久封存于储层，但增产的石油燃烧又会排放CO2。净气候效益取决于封存比例与替代效应，争议较大。
Both: injecting CO2 boosts recovery and permanently stores some in the reservoir, but the extra oil burned emits CO2. Net climate benefit depends on storage fraction and displacement effects—contested.

#CCUS #EOR #权衡

CCUS 是什么，和单纯“碳捕集”有什么不同？

What is CCUS and how does it differ from mere carbon capture?

CCUS 是碳捕集、利用与封存：先捕集工业或电厂CO2，再将其封存到地下（驱油、咸水层）或转化为化学品、建材等利用。多了“利用U”和“封存S”环节。
CCUS is Carbon Capture, Utilization and Storage: capture CO2 from industry or power, then store it underground (EOR, saline aquifers) or convert it to chemicals, building materials, etc. It adds utilization and storage to capture alone.
